name: Hilton Cancun, An All Inclusive Resort
positioning: Family-friendly all-inclusive resort tucked into a mangrove forest on the ocean's edge outside Cancun
best_for: Travelers who want an all-inclusive stay with ocean-front suites

facts.text: Rooms are minimalist in design, with a focus on light wood and creams.
The resort has 12 all-inclusive dining options, including five specialty restaurants.
Auma is an open-fire mixed grill featuring prime cuts, where meals unfold in full view of fire and flame.
The complimentary Kid's Club is for kids aged 4 to 12.
There is a tour company on site to help with excursions.
The staff are bilingual in Spanish and English.
Rooms come with complimentary water in recycled glass bottles that the property cleans and repurposes.
Designated accessible rooms have roll-in showers and braille signage.

highlights.text: The resort is tucked deep in a mangrove forest and sits on the ocean's edge.
The Deluxe Ocean Front Suite has a large living room with sofa and dining table, a king-sized bed and sitting area, two bathrooms and sweeping ocean front views.
Accommodations range from ocean-view rooms to options with private swim-up patios, for two to six people.
A dedicated family splash playground has slides, water toys and beach games.
A dedicated TeensZone for ages 13 to 17 has TV, video and board games, and ping pong tables.

considerations.text: The property is fairly isolated, and walking into Cancun town is not an option, so guests need to plan transportation ahead.
Some specialty restaurants offer extra menu options for an additional fee.
WhataHotel notes the large resort may feel crowded during peak seasons.
